title: never auto tab date fields
name: Never auto tab date fields — GOV.UK
pass_when: Focus stays in the current day, month, or year field until the user moves it.
fail_when: Completing one segment auto-tabs into the next.
overview: Never auto-tab between day, month, and year date fields.
not_when: Not for single-field dates, or intentional user-driven focus moves.
agent_hint: Leave focus in the current date segment until the user moves it.
description: Focus must stay in the current day, month, or year field until the user moves it. Never auto-tab into the next segment when one is completed; automatic jumps surprise keyboard and assistive-tech users and cause mistyped dates. Let people move between segments themselves. Fail if finishing a segment automatically jumps focus to the next. Apply whenever you implement segmented day/month/year date inputs.
